structural-causal.name: bottleneckControl
structural-causal.basis: Current primary evidence supports participation in fast-growing networking/server infrastructure, but not exclusive control of the bottleneck.

structural-causal.name: scenarioRobustness
structural-causal.basis: Demand can remain strong across AI buildout scenarios, while customer insourcing, program loss or capex normalization can break the company-specific transmission.

structural-causal.name: substitutionResilience
structural-causal.basis: Manufacturing capability is useful across platform generations, but customer redesign and alternate manufacturers remain substitutes.

discovery-weak-signals.name: AI hardware manufacturing exposure
discovery-weak-signals.basis: Strong growth and raised outlook align with strengthening data-center infrastructure demand.

adversarial-red-team.name: thesisQuality
adversarial-red-team.basis: Operating evidence is strong, while customer/program concentration and competitive substitution are not quantified.

adversarial-red-team.name: supplyChainResilience
adversarial-red-team.basis: Reviewed evidence does not establish component concentration or alternate-source resilience.

expectations-execution.name: Operating leverage
expectations-execution.basis: Margin and EPS expansion accompanied rapid revenue growth.
